claims.evidence: This is a conclusion drawn from the spot test data.

claims.claim: The majority of gene expression changes observed upon loss of ISWI or ACF1 occurred outside of H3K27-methylated domains.
claims.source: We found that while the majority of gene expression changes observed upon loss of ISWI or ACF1 occurred outside of H3K27-methylated domains (Figure 2—figure supplement 2A, B), genes marked by H3K27 methylation were significantly enriched in the upregulated gene sets for ∆iswi and ∆acf1 strains (Figure 2C and D).
claims.evidence: This is supported by mRNA-seq data shown in Figure 2—figure supplement 2A, B.

claims.claim: Genes marked by H3K27 methylation were significantly enriched in the upregulated gene sets for Δiswi and Δacf1 strains.
claims.source: We found that while the majority of gene expression changes observed upon loss of ISWI or ACF1 occurred outside of H3K27-methylated domains (Figure 2—figure supplement 2A, B), genes marked by H3K27 methylation were significantly enriched in the upregulated gene sets for ∆iswi and ∆acf1 strains (Figure 2C and D).
claims.evidence: This is supported by mRNA-seq data shown in Figure 2C and D.

claims.claim: H3K27-methylated genes were modestly enriched in the Δiaf-3 and Δiaf-2 gene sets.
claims.source: We found that H3K27-methylated genes were modestly enriched in the ∆iaf-3 and ∆iaf-2 gene sets (Figure 2E and F) but not enriched in the ∆iaf-1 gene set (Figure 2G).
claims.evidence: This is supported by mRNA-seq data shown in Figure 2E and F.

claims.claim: H3K27-methylated genes were not enriched in the Δiaf-1 gene set.
claims.source: We found that H3K27-methylated genes were modestly enriched in the ∆iaf-3 and ∆iaf-2 gene sets (Figure 2E and F) but not enriched in the ∆iaf-1 gene set (Figure 2G).
claims.evidence: This is supported by mRNA-seq data shown in Figure 2G.

claims.claim: Nearly all (92%) of the H3K27-methylated genes that were upregulated in Δacf1 were also upregulated in Δiswi.
claims.source: Nearly all (92%) of the H3K27-methylated genes that were upregulated in ∆acf1 were also upregulated in ∆iswi, showing significant (p<8.036E−54) overlap between these two gene sets (Figure 2H).
claims.evidence: This is supported by mRNA-seq data and statistical analysis shown in Figure 2H.

claims.claim: Only 30% of H3K27-methylated genes upregulated in Δiswi or Δacf1 were part of the Δset-7 upregulated gene set.
claims.source: Only 30% of these genes were part of the ∆set-7 upregulated gene set (Figure 2—figure supplement 2C), consistent with the notion that the repression of H3K27-methylated genes is not solely a result of PRC2 activity.
claims.evidence: This is supported by mRNA-seq data shown in Figure 2—figure supplement 2C.

claims.claim: The repression of H3K27-methylated genes is not solely a result of PRC2 activity.
claims.source: Only 30% of these genes were part of the ∆set-7 upregulated gene set (Figure 2—figure supplement 2C), consistent with the notion that the repression of H3K27-methylated genes is not solely a result of PRC2 activity.
claims.evidence: This is an inference based on the limited overlap between upregulated genes in ACF mutants and Δset-7.

claims.claim: ISWI and ACF1 are necessary for the repression of a large overlapping set of H3K27-methylated genes.
claims.source: This demonstrates that ISWI and ACF1 are not simply involved in the repression of the two H3K27-methylated genes that we used in our initial selection (NCU05173 and NCU07152) but are also necessary for the repression of a large overlapping set of H3K27-methylated genes.
claims.evidence: This is a conclusion drawn from the mRNA-seq data.

claims.claim: Loss of H3K27 methylation is associated with derepression of genes in facultative heterochromatin.
claims.source: We know that loss of H3K27 methylation (Jamieson et al., 2013) or loss of H3K36 methylation (Bicocca et al., 2018) is associated with derepression of genes in facultative heterochromatin.
claims.evidence: This is established knowledge from previous studies by the authors, supported by citations.

claims.claim: Loss of H3K36 methylation is associated with derepression of genes in facultative heterochromatin.
claims.source: We know that loss of H3K27 methylation (Jamieson et al., 2013) or loss of H3K36 methylation (Bicocca et al., 2018) is associated with derepression of genes in facultative heterochromatin.
claims.evidence: This is established knowledge from previous studies by the authors, supported by citations.

claims.claim: Changes in H3K36me2 in Δiswi and Δacf1 mutants were negligible.
claims.source: We found that changes in H3K36me2 in each of these mutants were negligible (Figure 3—figure supplement 1A, B).
claims.evidence: This is supported by ChIP-seq data shown in Figure 3—figure supplement 1A, B.

claims.claim: Minor loss of both H3K27me2/3 and H3K36me3 was observed in Δacf1 strains.
claims.source: We saw minor loss of both H3K27me2/3 and H3K36me3 in ∆acf1, and more changes in these histone marks in ∆iswi strains (Figure 3A–D).
claims.evidence: This is supported by ChIP-seq data shown in Figure 3A–D.

claims.claim: More changes in H3K27me2/3 and H3K36me3 were observed in Δiswi strains compared to Δacf1.
claims.source: We saw minor loss of both H3K27me2/3 and H3K36me3 in ∆acf1, and more changes in these histone marks in ∆iswi strains (Figure 3A–D).
claims.evidence: This is supported by ChIP-seq data shown in Figure 3A–D.

claims.claim: H3K27me2/3 ChIP-seq of strains with Δiaf-3, Δiaf-1, or Δiaf-2 showed only minor changes in H3K27me2/3.
claims.source: H3K27me2/3 ChIP-seq of strains with genes for other ISWI-interacting proteins deleted (∆iaf-3, ∆iaf-1, or ∆iaf-2) showed only minor changes in H3K27me2/3 (Figure 3—figure supplement 2A-C).
claims.evidence: This is supported by ChIP-seq data shown in Figure 3—figure supplement 2A-C.

claims.claim: There was a negative correlation between H3K27me2/3 and gene expression in both Δiswi (r=–0.404) and Δacf1 (r=–0.36) strains.
claims.source: We found that there was a negative correlation between H3K27me2/3 and gene expression in both ∆iswi (r=–0.404) and ∆acf1 (r=–0.36) strains (Figure 3E and F) while there was no correlation between H3K36me3 and gene expression in these strains (Figure 3G and H).
claims.evidence: This is supported by correlation analysis of ChIP-seq and mRNA-seq data shown in Figure 3E and F.

claims.claim: There was no correlation between H3K36me3 and gene expression in Δiswi and Δacf1 strains.
claims.source: We found that there was a negative correlation between H3K27me2/3 and gene expression in both ∆iswi (r=–0.404) and ∆acf1 (r=–0.36) strains (Figure 3E and F) while there was no correlation between H3K36me3 and gene expression in these strains (Figure 3G and H).
claims.evidence: This is supported by correlation analysis of ChIP-seq and mRNA-seq data shown in Figure 3G and H.

claims.claim: The majority of upregulated genes (51% in Δiswi and 74% in Δacf1) had no significant loss of H3K27 methylation.
claims.source: Despite the negative correlation between H3K27me2/3 level and gene expression, the majority of upregulated genes—51% and 74% for ∆iswi and ∆acf1, respectively—had no significant loss of H3K27 methylation (Figure 3E and F).
claims.evidence: This is supported by analysis of ChIP-seq and mRNA-seq data shown in Figure 3E and F.

claims.claim: Large domains of H3K27me2/3 were lost in Δiswi strains.
claims.source: We looked at the distribution of H3K27me2/3 and H3K36me3 along the chromosomes (Figure 3I and J and Figure 3—figure supplement 2D) and found that while much of the H3K27me2/3 and H3K36me3 resembled wild type, large domains of H3K27me2/3 were lost in ∆iswi strains whereas more discrete decreases in H3K36me3 were observed in ∆iswi strains and to a lesser degree in ∆acf1 strains (Figure 3I–K).
claims.evidence: This is supported by ChIP-seq data shown in Figure 3I–K and Figure 3—figure supplement 2D.

claims.claim: More discrete decreases in H3K36me3 were observed in Δiswi strains and to a lesser degree in Δacf1 strains.
claims.source: We looked at the distribution of H3K27me2/3 and H3K36me3 along the chromosomes (Figure 3I and J and Figure 3—figure supplement 2D) and found that while much of the H3K27me2/3 and H3K36me3 resembled wild type, large domains of H3K27me2/3 were lost in ∆iswi strains whereas more discrete decreases in H3K36me3 were observed in ∆iswi strains and to a lesser degree in ∆acf1 strains (Figure 3I–K).
claims.evidence: This is supported by ChIP-seq data shown in Figure 3I–K and Figure 3—figure supplement 2D.

claims.claim: Many upregulated genes in Δiswi fell in regions that showed wild-type H3K27me2/3 and H3K36me3.
claims.source: We examined the gene expression changes along the left arm of LG IV in the ∆iswi strain and confirmed that many upregulated genes fell in regions that showed wild-type H3K27me2/3 and H3K36me3 (Figure 3K).
claims.evidence: This is supported by integrated analysis of ChIP-seq and mRNA-seq data shown in Figure 3K.

claims.claim: ChIP-qPCR at the H3K27-methylated marker genes (NCU05173 and NCU07152) validated that loss of H3K27 methylation is not required for transcriptional upregulation in Δiswi and Δacf1 strains.
claims.source: ChIP-qPCR at the H3K27-methylated marker genes (NCU05173 and NCU07152) further validated the finding that loss of H3K27 methylation is not required for transcriptional upregulation in ∆iswi and ∆acf1 strains (Figure 3L).
claims.evidence: This is supported by ChIP-qPCR data shown in Figure 3L.

claims.claim: Loss of H3K27 methylation is not a prerequisite for upregulating genes in facultative heterochromatin.
claims.source: This is consistent with our previous findings showing that loss of H3K27 methylation is not a prerequisite for upregulating genes in facultative heterochromatin (Wiles et al., 2020).
claims.evidence: This is supported by a citation to previous work by the authors.

claims.claim: iswi is required for normal H3K27me2/3 and H3K36me3.
claims.source: Taken together, these data show that iswi is required for normal H3K27me2/3 and H3K36me3, while loss of acf1 results in minor changes, suggesting that the ACF complex does not play a major role in directing or maintaining these histone modifications.
claims.evidence: This is a conclusion drawn from the ChIP-seq data.

claims.claim: Loss of acf1 results in minor changes in H3K27me2/3 and H3K36me3.
claims.source: Taken together, these data show that iswi is required for normal H3K27me2/3 and H3K36me3, while loss of acf1 results in minor changes, suggesting that the ACF complex does not play a major role in directing or maintaining these histone modifications.
claims.evidence: This is a conclusion drawn from the ChIP-seq data.

claims.claim: The ACF complex does not play a major role in directing or maintaining H3K27me2/3 and H3K36me3.
claims.source: Taken together, these data show that iswi is required for normal H3K27me2/3 and H3K36me3, while loss of acf1 results in minor changes, suggesting that the ACF complex does not play a major role in directing or maintaining these histone modifications.
claims.evidence: This is an inference based on the observation that many upregulated genes retain these histone marks.

claims.claim: Loss of H3K27me2/3 or H3K36me3 is not required for transcriptional upregulation in facultative heterochromatin.
claims.source: Furthermore, loss of these histone marks is not required for transcriptional upregulation in facultative heterochromatin.
claims.evidence: This is a conclusion drawn from the combined ChIP-seq and mRNA-seq data.

claims.claim: ACF1 localization is not restricted to one part of the genome, but rather appears to interact with chromatin genome-wide.
claims.source: We found that ACF1 localization is not restricted to one part of the genome, but rather appears to interact with chromatin genome-wide (Figure 4A and B).
claims.evidence: This is supported by DamID-seq data shown in Figure 4A and B.

claims.claim: When set-7 was deleted, ACF1 localization to H3K27-methylated regions was reduced relative to wild type.
claims.source: However, when set-7 was deleted, eliminating H3K27 methylation, ACF1 localization to H3K27-methylated regions was reduced relative to wild type, suggesting that H3K27 methylation, or SET-7 presence, promotes ACF1 interactions specifically with these genomic regions (Figure 4A and B, Figure 4—figure supplement 1A, B).
claims.evidence: This is supported by DamID-seq data shown in Figure 4A and B, Figure 4—figure supplement 1A, B.

claims.claim: H3K27 methylation, or SET-7 presence, promotes ACF1 interactions specifically with H3K27-methylated genomic regions.
claims.source: However, when set-7 was deleted, eliminating H3K27 methylation, ACF1 localization to H3K27-methylated regions was reduced relative to wild type, suggesting that H3K27 methylation, or SET-7 presence, promotes ACF1 interactions specifically with these genomic regions (Figure 4A and B, Figure 4—figure supplement 1A, B).
claims.evidence: This is an inference based on the DamID-seq data comparing wild-type and Δset-7 strains.

claims.claim: Deletion of set-7 had no effect on ACF1-Dam localization at a euchromatic region (his-3).
claims.source: In contrast, deletion of set-7 had no effect on ACF1-Dam localization at a euchromatic region (his-3) (Figure 4—figure supplement 1A).
claims.evidence: This is supported by DamID Southern blot data shown in Figure 4—figure supplement 1A.

claims.claim: Both ACF1-Dam and Free-Dam localized to non-H3K27-methylated genes at similar levels, independent of set-7 presence.
claims.source: When we compared ACF1-Dam localization to that of a nonspecific control (Dam only; referred to as Free-Dam), we found that both constructs localized to non-H3K27-methylated genes at similar levels, and this was independent of set-7 presence (Figure 4C).
claims.evidence: This is supported by DamID-seq data shown in Figure 4C.

claims.claim: ACF1-Dam localized to H3K27-methylated genes more than Free-Dam and this increased localization was partially dependent on set-7.
claims.source: In contrast, ACF1-Dam localized to H3K27-methylated genes more than Free-Dam and this increased localization was partially dependent on set-7 (Figure 4D).
claims.evidence: This is supported by DamID-seq data shown in Figure 4D.

claims.claim: ACF1 association with facultative heterochromatin is promoted by, but not fully dependent on, an intact PRC2 complex and/or H3K27 methylation.
claims.source: These data suggest that ACF1 association with facultative heterochromatin is promoted by, but not fully dependent on, an intact PRC2 complex and/or H3K27 methylation.
claims.evidence: This is an inference based on the DamID-seq data showing partial dependence on SET-7.

claims.claim: When all genes or only H3K27-methylated regions were considered, only minor changes in nucleosome repeat length were found between wild-type and mutant strains.
claims.source: When we looked genome-wide or considered only H3K27-methylated regions, we found only minor changes in nucleosome repeat length between wild-type and mutant strains (∆iswi, ∆acf1, ∆iaf-3, ∆iaf-1, ∆iaf-2, and ∆set-7) (Figure 5—figure supplement 1A, B).
claims.evidence: This is supported by MNase-seq data analyzed using the autocorrelation function, shown in Figure 5—figure supplement 1A, B.

claims.claim: ISWI-containing complexes do not have major contributions to global nucleosome spacing in N. crassa or there is redundancy among these proteins.
claims.source: This suggested that ISWI-containing complexes do not have major contributions to global nucleosome spacing in N. crassa or there is redundancy among these proteins.
claims.evidence: This is an inference based on the minor changes in nucleosome repeat length.

claims.claim: Deletion of iswi or acf1 was more likely to result in a downstream shift (>30 bp) of the +1 nucleosome than when iaf-3, iaf-1, iaf-2, or set-7 were deleted.
claims.source: We found that when all SD genes were considered, deletion of iswi or acf1 was more likely to result in a downstream shift (>30 bp) of the +1 nucleosome than when iaf-3, iaf-1, iaf-2, or set-7 were deleted (Figure 5—figure supplement 2A).
claims.evidence: This is supported by MNase-seq data shown in Figure 5—figure supplement 2A.

claims.claim: The trend of downstream nucleosome shift in Δiswi and Δacf1 held when only H3K27-methylated SD genes were considered.
claims.source: This trend held when only H3K27-methylated SD genes (n=358) were considered (Figure 5A).
claims.evidence: This is supported by MNase-seq data shown in Figure 5A.

claims.claim: A significant portion of the H3K27-methylated genes with a shifted nucleosome is shared between iswi and acf1 (p<9.91E−13).
claims.source: Importantly, a significant portion of the H3K27-methylated genes with a shifted nucleosome is shared between iswi and acf1 (p<9.91E−13) (Figure 5B).
claims.evidence: This is supported by statistical analysis of MNase-seq data shown in Figure 5B.

claims.claim: ISWI and ACF1 may work in concert to position the +1 nucleosome at a subset of genes, including those in H3K27-methylated regions.
claims.source: These data suggest that ISWI and ACF1 may work in concert to position the +1 nucleosome at a subset of genes, including those in H3K27-methylated regions.
claims.evidence: This is an inference based on the shared nucleosome shifts in Δiswi and Δacf1 strains.

claims.claim: The +1 nucleosome shifted downstream in the absence of iswi or acf1 at H3K27-methylated SD genes.
claims.source: The MNase signal plots revealed that the +1 nucleosome shifted downstream in the absence of iswi or acf1 (Figure 5C and D); in contrast, no shift was seen when other ISWI-interacting partners (∆iaf-3, ∆iaf-1, and ∆iaf-2) were deleted (Figure 5E; Figure 5—figure supplement 2C, D).
claims.evidence: This is supported by MNase-seq data shown in Figure 5C and D.

claims.claim: No nucleosome shift was seen when other ISWI-interacting partners (Δiaf-3, Δiaf-1, and Δiaf-2) were deleted.
claims.source: The MNase signal plots revealed that the +1 nucleosome shifted downstream in the absence of iswi or acf1 (Figure 5C and D); in contrast, no shift was seen when other ISWI-interacting partners (∆iaf-3, ∆iaf-1, and ∆iaf-2) were deleted (Figure 5E; Figure 5—figure supplement 2C, D).
claims.evidence: This is supported by MNase-seq data shown in Figure 5E and Figure 5—figure supplement 2C, D.

claims.claim: There was no nucleosome shift observed in Δset-7 strains when all H3K27-methylated SD genes were considered.
claims.source: There was also no shift observed in ∆set-7 strains when all H3K27-methylated SD genes were considered (Figure 5F).
claims.evidence: This is supported by MNase-seq data shown in Figure 5F.

claims.claim: ISWI and ACF1 act to position the +1 nucleosome at a substantial subset of H3K27-methylated genes.
claims.source: These findings suggest that ISWI and ACF1 act to position the +1 nucleosome at a substantial subset of H3K27-methylated genes.
claims.evidence: This is a conclusion drawn from the MNase-seq data.

claims.claim: SET-7, and hence H3K27 methylation, is not required for nucleosome positioning by ISWI/ACF1.
claims.source: Furthermore, SET-7, and hence H3K27 methylation, is not required for nucleosome positioning by ISWI/ACF1.
claims.evidence: This is an inference based on the lack of nucleosome shift in Δset-7 strains.

claims.claim: The +1 nucleosome shifted 50-bp downstream on average at H3K27-methylated SD genes that were upregulated (FDR <0.05) in Δacf1 strains.
claims.source: We found that the +1 nucleosome shifted 50-bp downstream on average at H3K27-methylated SD genes that were upregulated (FDR <0.05) in ∆acf1 strains (Figure 5G), whereas no such shift was seen in the +1 nucleosome of H3K27-methylated SD genes that were not upregulated in ∆acf1 strains (Figure 5H).
claims.evidence: This is supported by MNase-seq data shown in Figure 5G.

claims.claim: No nucleosome shift was seen in the +1 nucleosome of H3K27-methylated SD genes that were not upregulated in Δacf1 strains.
claims.source: We found that the +1 nucleosome shifted 50-bp downstream on average at H3K27-methylated SD genes that were upregulated (FDR <0.05) in ∆acf1 strains (Figure 5G), whereas no such shift was seen in the +1 nucleosome of H3K27-methylated SD genes that were not upregulated in ∆acf1 strains (Figure 5H).
claims.evidence: This is supported by MNase-seq data shown in Figure 5H.

claims.claim: H3K27-methylated genes that were upregulated (FDR <0.05) in Δiswi display a more prominent downstream shift of the +1 nucleosome than those genes that were not upregulated.
claims.source: Similarly, H3K27-methylated genes that were upregulated (FDR <0.05) in ∆iswi display a more prominent downstream shift of the +1 nucleosome than those genes that were not upregulated (Figure 5I and J).
claims.evidence: This is supported by MNase-seq data shown in Figure 5I and J.

claims.claim: Positioning of the +1 nucleosome by ISWI and ACF1 at a subset of H3K27-methylated genes contributes to transcriptional repression.
claims.source: Taken together, these data suggest that positioning of the +1 nucleosome by ISWI and ACF1 at a subset of H3K27-methylated genes contributes to transcriptional repression.
claims.evidence: This is a conclusion drawn from the correlation between nucleosome shifts and gene upregulation.

claims.claim: No nucleosome shift was found at non-H3K27-methylated genes that are upregulated in Δiswi or Δacf1.
claims.source: We found no nucleosome shift at non-H3K27-methylated genes that are upregulated in ∆iswi or ∆acf1 (Figure 5K and L).
claims.evidence: This is supported by MNase-seq data shown in Figure 5K and L.

claims.claim: The upregulation at non-H3K27-methylated targets in Δiswi or Δacf1 is through a different mechanism or is an indirect effect.
claims.source: This suggests that the upregulation at non-H3K27-methylated targets is through a different mechanism or is an indirect effect.
claims.evidence: This is an inference based on the lack of nucleosome shift at non-H3K27-methylated upregulated genes.

claims.claim: No nucleosome shift was found at H3K27-methylated genes that are upregulated in Δset-7.
claims.source: We also looked at the nucleosome positions in H3K27-methylated genes that are upregulated in ∆set-7 (Figure 5M). We found no nucleosome shift at these genes.
claims.evidence: This is supported by MNase-seq data shown in Figure 5M.

claims.claim: Transcriptional upregulation is not sufficient to induce a nucleosome shift.
claims.source: Taken together, this shows that transcriptional upregulation is not sufficient to induce a nucleosome shift.
claims.evidence: This is a conclusion drawn from the observation that upregulated genes in Δset-7 and non-H3K27-methylated genes in ACF mutants do not show nucleosome shifts.

claims.claim: The findings support a model in which ACF acts directly at H3K27-methylated, upregulated genes.
claims.source: These findings support a model in which ACF acts directly at H3K27-methylated, upregulated genes.
claims.evidence: This is a conclusion drawn from the specificity of nucleosome shifts to H3K27-methylated upregulated genes in ACF mutants.

claims.claim: Five clusters emerged from the clustered heatmap of gene expression data for H3K27-methylated genes in various mutant strains.
claims.source: We created a clustered heatmap of the gene expression data and found that five clusters emerged (Figure 6A).
claims.evidence: This is supported by the clustered heatmap shown in Figure 6A.

claims.claim: Cluster 1 included genes that were upregulated in every mutant strain except Δepr-1.
claims.source: Cluster 1 included genes that were upregulated in every mutant strain except ∆epr-1.
claims.evidence: This is an observation from the clustered heatmap shown in Figure 6A.

claims.claim: Cluster 2 contained genes that were highly upregulated in Δiswi, ash1Y888F, or Δacf1 strains.
claims.source: Cluster 2 contained genes that were highly upregulated in ∆iswi, ash1Y888F(a catalytic null) or ∆acf1 strains, while cluster 3 genes were only upregulated in ∆iswi or ash1Y888Fstrains.
claims.evidence: This is an observation from the clustered heatmap shown in Figure 6A.

claims.claim: Cluster 3 genes were only upregulated in Δiswi or ash1Y888F strains.
claims.source: Cluster 2 contained genes that were highly upregulated in ∆iswi, ash1Y888F(a catalytic null) or ∆acf1 strains, while cluster 3 genes were only upregulated in ∆iswi or ash1Y888Fstrains.
claims.evidence: This is an observation from the clustered heatmap shown in Figure 6A.

claims.claim: The fourth and largest cluster contained genes that were not highly upregulated in any mutant strain.
claims.source: The fourth and largest cluster contained genes that were not highly upregulated in any mutant strain.
claims.evidence: This is an observation from the clustered heatmap shown in Figure 6A.

claims.claim: The final cluster contained genes with more varied expression among the mutant strains, but perhaps showed some enrichment for genes upregulated in Δset-7 and Δepr-1 strains.
claims.source: The final cluster contained genes with more varied expression among the mutant strains, but perhaps showed some enrichment for genes upregulated in ∆set-7 and ∆epr-1 strains.
claims.evidence: This is an observation from the clustered heatmap shown in Figure 6A.

claims.claim: There is striking overlap between gene expression profiles of Δiswi and ash1Y888F strains.
claims.source: The heatmap revealed striking overlap between gene expression profiles of ∆iswi and ash1Y888Fstrains, which prompted us to investigate this relationship further.
claims.evidence: This is an observation from the clustered heatmap shown in Figure 6A.

claims.claim: iswi is not required for H3K36me2.
claims.source: We previously showed that iswi is not required for H3K36me2 (Figure 3—figure supplement 1), the predominant histone mark catalyzed by ASH1.
claims.evidence: This is supported by ChIP-seq data shown in Figure 3—figure supplement 1.

claims.claim: No nucleosome shift was observed in ash1 mutant strains at H3K27-methylated genes that are upregulated when iswi is deleted.
claims.source: In contrast to the prominent downstream nucleosome shift we saw in this gene set in ∆iswi strains, we observed no nucleosome shift in ash1 mutant strains (Figure 6—figure supplement 1A).
claims.evidence: This is supported by MNase-seq data shown in Figure 6—figure supplement 1A.

claims.claim: ISWI and ASH1 act in distinct, perhaps parallel, pathways to regulate a common set of H3K27-methylated genes.
claims.source: These data suggest that ISWI and ASH1 act in distinct, perhaps parallel, pathways to regulate a common set of H3K27-methylated genes.
claims.evidence: This is an inference based on the lack of nucleosome shift in ash1 mutants despite similar gene expression changes.

claims.claim: Methylation of lysine 27 of histone H3, catalyzed by Enhancer of Zeste in the PRC2 complex, is associated with, and important for, gene repression in facultative heterochromatin.
claims.source: Pioneering work on the Polycomb system of Drosophila revealed that methylation of lysine 27 of histone H3, catalyzed by Enhancer of Zeste in the PRC2 complex, is associated with, and important for, gene repression in facultative heterochromatin (Kassis et al., 2017).
claims.evidence: This is established knowledge supported by a citation.

claims.claim: The PRC1 complex is widely regarded as central to Polycomb function in Drosophila and higher organisms.
claims.source: For example, the PRC1 complex, which is widely regarded as central to Polycomb function in Drosophila and higher organisms, is less conserved than PRC2, and at least in some organisms, is absent (Schuettengruber et al., 2017).
claims.evidence: This is established knowledge supported by a citation.

claims.claim: The PRC1 complex is less conserved than PRC2.
claims.source: For example, the PRC1 complex, which is widely regarded as central to Polycomb function in Drosophila and higher organisms, is less conserved than PRC2, and at least in some organisms, is absent (Schuettengruber et al., 2017).
claims.evidence: This is established knowledge supported by a citation.

claims.claim: Polycomb response elements (PREs) do not appear to be universal.
claims.source: Similarly, Polycomb response elements (PREs), cis-acting DNA sequences controlling the distribution of H3K27 methylation in Drosophila, do not appear to be universal (Kassis and Brown, 2013).
claims.evidence: This is established knowledge supported by a citation.

claims.claim: The PRC2 complex of Neurospora methylates H3K27 in roughly 7% of the genome.
claims.source: We defined the PRC2 complex of Neurospora, demonstrated that it methylates H3K27 in roughly 7% of the genome, and is necessary for repression of scores of genes even though it is not essential in this organism (Jamieson et al., 2013; McNaught et al., 2020).
claims.evidence: This is supported by citations to previous work by the authors.

claims.claim: The PRC2 complex is necessary for repression of scores of genes in Neurospora even though it is not essential in this organism.

results.result: A forward genetic selection in N. crassa identified iswi and acf1 as genes required for silencing H3K27-methylated genes. UV mutagenesis followed by drug selection identified point mutations in iswi (L430P) and acf1 (D161fs). Deletion of either gene resulted in drug resistance, and complementation with wild-type copies restored silencing.
results.evaluation: Claims C32-C53 describe a well-designed forward genetic selection with appropriate controls. The identification of mutations was confirmed by whole-genome sequencing and SNP mapping (C44-C47), deletion strains phenocopied the original mutants (C48), and complementation tests validated the causal genes (C49). The experimental design and validation steps provide strong support for this result.

results.result: ISWI and ACF1 form a chromatin-remodeling complex in N. crassa. Immunoprecipitation followed by mass spectrometry showed that ISWI co-purifies with ACF1, as well as with other accessory factors (IAF-3, IAF-1, IAF-2) and histone fold proteins (HFP-1, HFP-2), suggesting ISWI forms multiple distinct protein complexes.
results.evaluation: Claims C3-C62 are supported by reciprocal immunoprecipitation and mass spectrometry data showing protein-protein interactions. The identification of multiple ISWI-interacting partners with high unique peptide counts (C55, C56, C60) provides strong biochemical evidence for complex formation. The data are consistent with known ISWI complexes in other organisms (C54).

results.result: ISWI and ACF1 are necessary for repression of a subset of H3K27-methylated genes. mRNA-seq showed that genes marked by H3K27 methylation were significantly enriched in upregulated gene sets for Δiswi and Δacf1 strains, with 92% overlap between the two mutants. Only 30% of upregulated genes overlapped with Δset-7, indicating repression is not solely due to PRC2 activity.
results.evaluation: Claims C35-C75 are supported by mRNA-seq data showing significant enrichment of H3K27-methylated genes in upregulated gene sets (C69), with statistical validation of overlap between mutants (C72, p<8.036E-54). The limited overlap with Δset-7 (C73) supports the conclusion that ACF acts independently of H3K27 methylation loss. The data demonstrate genome-wide effects beyond the selection markers.

results.result: Derepression of H3K27-methylated genes in ACF mutants is not simply due to loss of H3K27 methylation. ChIP-seq showed that the majority of upregulated genes (51% in Δiswi and 74% in Δacf1) retained H3K27 methylation. While iswi is required for normal H3K27me2/3 and H3K36me3 levels, loss of acf1 results in only minor changes, suggesting the ACF complex does not play a major role in directing or maintaining these histone modifications.
results.evaluation: Claims C36-C93 are supported by ChIP-seq data showing that many upregulated genes retain H3K27 methylation (C84, C87, C88). The negative correlation between H3K27me2/3 and gene expression (C82) does not explain all upregulation. ChIP-qPCR validation at marker genes (C88) and consistency with prior work (C89) strengthen this conclusion. The differential effects of iswi vs. acf1 deletion on histone marks (C79-C80, C90-C91) support distinct roles.

results.result: ACF interacts with chromatin throughout the genome, but association with facultative heterochromatin is specifically promoted by SET-7. DamID-seq showed ACF1 localizes genome-wide, but localization to H3K27-methylated regions was reduced in Δset-7 strains. ACF1-Dam localized to H3K27-methylated genes more than Free-Dam control, and this increased localization was partially dependent on set-7.
results.evaluation: Claims C5-C100 are supported by DamID-seq data showing genome-wide ACF1 localization (C94) with specific enrichment at H3K27-methylated regions that is partially SET-7-dependent (C95, C96, C99). The use of Free-Dam as a control (C98) and validation by Southern blot (C97) strengthen the findings. The partial dependence on SET-7 (C100) is appropriately stated as an inference from the data.

results.result: Loss of ACF results in a downstream shift of the +1 nucleosome at H3K27-methylated genes. MNase-seq showed that deletion of iswi or acf1 was more likely to result in a downstream shift (>30 bp) of the +1 nucleosome at H3K27-methylated genes compared to other mutants. A significant portion of genes with shifted nucleosomes is shared between iswi and acf1 (p<9.91E-13). No shift was observed in Δset-7 strains, indicating SET-7 is not required for nucleosome positioning by ISWI/ACF1.
results.evaluation: Claims C7-C111 are supported by MNase-seq data showing specific downstream shifts of the +1 nucleosome in Δiswi and Δacf1 strains (C103, C104, C107) with significant overlap between mutants (C105, p<9.91E-13). The lack of shift in other ISWI-interacting partner mutants (C108) and Δset-7 (C109) supports specificity. The minor changes in global nucleosome spacing (C101) indicate targeted rather than genome-wide effects.

results.result: Positioning of the +1 nucleosome by ISWI and ACF1 at H3K27-methylated genes contributes to transcriptional repression. MNase-seq showed that H3K27-methylated genes upregulated in Δacf1 or Δiswi displayed a 50-bp downstream shift of the +1 nucleosome, while non-upregulated genes showed no shift. No nucleosome shift was found at non-H3K27-methylated upregulated genes or at H3K27-methylated genes upregulated in Δset-7, indicating transcriptional upregulation alone is not sufficient to induce a nucleosome shift.
results.evaluation: Claims C8-C165 are supported by MNase-seq data showing correlation between nucleosome shifts and gene upregulation specifically at H3K27-methylated genes (C112, C114). The lack of shifts at non-H3K27-methylated upregulated genes (C116) and at H3K27-methylated genes upregulated in Δset-7 (C118) provides strong evidence that nucleosome shifts are not simply a consequence of transcription (C119, C163). This supports direct ACF action at H3K27-methylated genes (C120, C164, C165).

results.result: The ACF complex plays a direct role in Polycomb repression through nucleosome positioning. Clustered heatmap analysis of gene expression data revealed five distinct clusters of H3K27-methylated genes with different responses to various mutants. Striking overlap between Δiswi and ash1Y888F gene expression profiles was observed, but no nucleosome shift was seen in ash1 mutants, suggesting ISWI and ASH1 act in distinct pathways. The findings support a model where ACF remodels chromatin at H3K27-methylated regions to contribute to Polycomb silencing.
results.evaluation: Claims C9-C170 integrate multiple lines of evidence to support the conclusion that ACF plays a direct role in Polycomb repression. The clustered heatmap analysis (C121-C126) reveals complex, non-linear repression mechanisms (C142). The comparison with ash1 mutants (C127-C130) demonstrates distinct pathways despite similar gene expression changes. The combined genetic, biochemical, and genomic data support the model of ACF-mediated chromatin remodeling contributing to Polycomb silencing (C169, C170).

results.result: Disruption of iswi or acf1 resulted in an early conidiation phenotype. The Δiswi strain showed decreased growth rate relative to wild type, while the Δacf1 strain grew comparably to wild type.
results.evaluation: Claims C50-C52 are supported by phenotypic observations from spot tests (C50) and linear growth rate measurements (C51, C52). These are straightforward observational data that provide additional characterization of the mutant phenotypes.

results.result: N. crassa ACF functions more like S. cerevisiae Isw2 than D. melanogaster ACF. The genetic identification of iswi and acf1 as genes required for silencing H3K27-methylated loci is consistent with evidence that chromatin structure plays a major role in transcriptional status. Nearly all H3K27-methylated genes upregulated in Δacf1 were also upregulated in Δiswi, consistent with a model where ACF1 targets ACF to chromatin but requires ISWI to catalyze nucleosome movement.
results.evaluation: Claims C145-C153 are supported by the nucleosome positioning data showing targeted +1 nucleosome shifts rather than global spacing effects, which is more consistent with yeast Isw2 function (C151) than fly ACF function (C152). The gene expression overlap between Δiswi and Δacf1 (C148) supports the proposed model of ACF1 targeting and ISWI catalysis. The comparison to other organisms (C150-C152) provides appropriate context.

results.result: The DamID-seq results are compatible with a 'continuous sampling' model for ACF. In this model, ACF transiently interacts with chromatin genome-wide in an autoinhibited conformation until a feature of facultative heterochromatin releases autoinhibition. The transient nature of ACF-chromatin interaction could account for the inability to confirm ACF1 DamID findings with ChIP.
results.evaluation: Claims C154-C162 propose a mechanistic model based on the DamID-seq data and existing literature (C157, C158). While the data showing genome-wide localization with specific activity at H3K27-methylated regions (C159) are consistent with this model, the model itself involves speculation about autoinhibition and transient interactions (C160, C161). The inability to perform ChIP (C161) limits direct validation of the proposed mechanism. The model is plausible but requires additional experimental validation.

results.result: Background knowledge on H3K27 methylation, facultative heterochromatin, nucleosome structure, and ACF complexes. H3K27 methylation is associated with repressed facultative heterochromatin, but mechanisms of repression are not fully understood. PRC1 is not present in all organisms with H3K27 methylation-associated silencing, suggesting additional mechanisms exist. Nucleosome positioning, particularly of the +1 nucleosome, is thought to be important for gene expression. ACF complexes have been linked to Polycomb repression in Drosophila.
results.evaluation: Claims C1-C31 represent established knowledge from the literature, supported by appropriate citations. These claims provide necessary context for the study and are well-supported by prior work. They establish the rationale for investigating ACF's role in Polycomb repression in an organism lacking PRC1.

results.result: Prior work on Polycomb systems and H3K27 methylation in Neurospora. The PRC2 complex methylates H3K27 in ~7% of the Neurospora genome and is necessary for repression of many genes. Neurospora has two distinct forms of H3K27 methylation: position-dependent (telomeric, NPF/PAS-dependent) and position-independent (interstitial, NPF/PAS-independent). ASH1, an H3K36 methyltransferase, is critical for maintaining repression in facultative heterochromatin.
results.evaluation: Claims C131-C140 summarize prior work by the authors and others on Polycomb systems, supported by appropriate citations. These claims establish the foundation for the current study and demonstrate the authors' previous characterization of the Neurospora Polycomb system. The claims are well-supported by the cited literature.

results.result: The role of ACF in Polycomb repression may be conserved across organisms. Isw2-mediated repression in yeast occurs by placing the +1 nucleosome over regulatory elements, though full repression may require additional factors like histone deacetylases. Despite differences in modes of action, the biological outcome of ACF/Isw2 complexes is transcriptional repression. ACF has been linked to Polycomb repression in flies, and ISWI components were identified in screens for Polycomb repression factors in mammalian cells.
results.evaluation: Claims C166-C173 are supported by citations to work in other organisms (C166, C167, C168, C171, C172). The speculation about conservation (C173) is appropriately qualified and based on findings in multiple systems. These claims provide important context for interpreting the significance of the Neurospora findings.
